title: The two marketing sites fetch their fonts from Google, but the privacy notice says our websites share nothing and never names this
what: Every visit to the gym-owner site and the member site makes the visitor's browser ask Google's servers for the fonts, which hands Google the visitor's address. The privacy notice says the websites use no cookies, no ads and no analytics, and its list of companies names Google only for sign-in, pop-ups, Play, Gemini and Drive. The notice also says the app is offered in the EU and UK, where a German court has fined a site for exactly this.
expected: Either the fonts are served from our own address, or the privacy notice says the websites load fonts from Google and what Google sees.
how_often: every visit to the two marketing sites
fix_line: Keep the font files on our own server, or add one line about Google fonts to the privacy notice

title: Both websites offer the free watch app, but the watch app is not out on Google Play for the public
what: The member site says 'Free on Wear OS watches' and 'The free MettleUp watch app works on Android (Wear OS) watches', and the gym-owner site says the same. In Play Console the watch app has no public release at all: it is only on internal and closed testing tracks, and the open testing version is waiting to be published. A visitor who reads the site and looks for the watch app on Play cannot get it. This is also a claim an ad regulator would count as misleading.
expected: The sites only promise the watch app once it is live for the public on Play, or they say it is in testing for now.
who: members and gym owners reading the sites
fix_line: Publish the watch app to the public on Play, or change the two lines to say it is in testing
